decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize Allosaurus Rider along with Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to quickly ramp into powerful creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck also includes a variety of combo pieces and support cards like Consign to Memory and Summoner's Pact to ensure consistency in executing the combo strategy. Additionally, cards like Pact of Negation and Planar Genesis provide control and board presence to further enhance the combo potential of the deck.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with blink effects to continually re-use and protect powerful creatures. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude while applying pressure with creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The blink effects from cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp allow for repeated triggers of valuable enters-the-battlefield abilities. By combining aggression with protection and recursion, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of threats and disrupt their game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to maintain a fast pace of attacking and dealing damage while also utilizing removal and control cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By efficiently utilizing low-cost creatures and versatile spells, the deck can maintain a strong offensive presence while also being able to adapt to different matchups and play styles. The combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and control elements creates a versatile aggro deck that can put pressure on opponents and secure victories.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and blink effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can repeatedly remove threats or protect its own creatures. Thoughtseize provides hand disruption while Fatal Push offers removal for early threats. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler provide the deck with strong aggressive options, while Witch Enchanter and Emperor of Bones offer additional synergy with blink effects. The deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan through blink shenanigans.

The main concept of this deck is to create a powerful combo using cards like Blade of the Bloodchief, Ancient Stirrings, Kozilek's Command, and Malevolent Rumble to generate a massive amount of mana and play high-cost creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Devourer of Destiny. The deck also utilizes cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Basking Broodscale to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the support of lands like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and combo potential.

Utilizing creature tokens and +1/+1 counters to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. This strategy focuses on generating tokens with Basking Broodscale and Blades of the Bloodchief, while also utilizing Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End for additional power. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Kozilek's Command to help assemble the combo pieces quickly. With the ability to generate large amounts of tokens and buff them with +1/+1 counters, this deck aims to create a formidable board presence and win the game through overwhelming force.

This deck focuses on using the combination of Birthing Ritual and powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Shardless Agent to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's strategy. In addition, there are cards like Misty Rainforest and Windswept Heath for mana fixing and deck thinning. The deck aims to maintain a balance between aggressive plays and controlling the game to secure a swift victory in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on explosive aggression using low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, supported by burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. It aims to quickly overwhelm opponents by dealing direct damage while maintaining card advantage through effects like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base allows for consistent access to both red and blue spells, with options for fetching specific lands with cards like Wooded Foothills and Scalding Tarn. The strategy is to maintain pressure and finish the game quickly before opponents can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizing burn spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. It aims to flood the board with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while using cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way and deal damage. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional support and buffs for the creatures, while cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory help to control the opponent's plays and maintain board advantage.

This Jeskai Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck includes a mix of powerful Planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler, board wipes like Wrath of the Skies, and efficient removal like Prismatic Ending. The deck also features card draw options like Consign to Memory and Tune the Narrative to help maintain card advantage. The goal is to control the game, eliminating threats and out-valuing the opponent until you can win with powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The key strategy is to maintain aggressive board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Mana Tithe and Blood Moon. The deck also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional card advantage and versatility. Overall, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently to secure victory in the early game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of cheap spells, countermagic, and creatures with strong enter-the-battlefield effects to win the game without relying on traditional lands. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting opponents' strategies, the deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed to activate Goblin Charbelcher, deal massive damage to the opponent, and secure the win. Additionally, the deck includes additional toolbox cards and disruption options to adapt to various matchups and strategies.

This deck focuses on quickly playing multiple artifacts, utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a high number of artifact creatures and powerful spells like Metallic Rebuke and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Urza's Saga is a key card that can help tutor for important artifacts, while Thought Monitor provides additional card draw. The synergy between artifacts and card advantage is crucial for maintaining tempo and pressuring the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually establishing a board presence. Key cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Thundertrap Trainer provide win conditions, while cards like Consult the Star Charts and Snapcaster Mage allow for card selection and recursion. The mana base enables flexibility and consistency in casting spells of various colors. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through careful management of resources and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of colorless mana, which is used to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control spells. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator, while also deploying threats like Devourer of Destiny and Sire of Seven Deaths to apply pressure. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of powerful creatures, control spells, and mana ramp, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with its efficient and versatile game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent using efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Pinnacle Emissary, while also relying on versatile burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to control the board and finish off the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Preordain help to maintain card advantage and dig for key cards, while Mox Opal and Astrologian's Planisphere provide ramp and mana fixing. Portable Hole can be used to remove problematic creatures or artifacts, and Expressive Iteration helps to filter through the deck for the right answers.
